name: ServiceQA
source: Derived from self-hosted support and knowledge-base assistants; five FastAPI services in this suite, built on sentence-transformers, FAISS, rank-bm25, a cross-encoder reranker and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
workflow: Services (servers/service_qa) and client (workloads/service_qa/qa_client.py) are part of this suite.

models.name: Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
models.settings: float16 on CUDA, greedy decoding, chat template with one user turn

datasets.name: MS MARCO v2.1 (dev / validation split)
datasets.license: MS MARCO terms and conditions: non-commercial research purposes only; no license or other intellectual property rights extended (microsoft.github.io/msmarco). The Hugging Face card gives no license.

corpus_embeddings.note: reference made on CUDA with torch 2.14.1 and sentence-transformers 6.2.0; not expected to be bit-identical elsewhere

equivalence: workloads/service_qa/check.py: rerank_doc_ids and prompt identical, rerank_scores within 1e-4; answer and merged_doc_ids reported
adaptations: Tracing removed from the services and the client (per-request trace records and the client-side merge and prompt records).

Endpoints and options the workflow does not call are not included: each service exposes only GET /health and the one POST endpoint the workflow calls. The reranker no longer loads a doc_id-to-passage table (used only for candidates sent without passage text).

Model revisions are pinned through RAG_EMBED_REVISION, RAG_RERANK_REVISION and RAG_QWEN_REVISION, set to the snapshots the reference deployment had in its model cache; the reference services loaded the default branch.
The generator defaults to the Qwen backend and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, the configuration of the reference runs (the original service defaulted to a template backend and Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct).
The corpus is rebuilt from the parquet with pyarrow instead of the datasets library; the output is byte-identical (sha256 checked).
Query texts are not stored in the manifests; prepare_data.py extracts them from the parquet.

development_hardware.server: 1x NVIDIA A40 (46 GB), AMD EPYC 7763, RHEL 9.6, Python 3.10.22, all five services on one node
development_hardware.client: Apple Mac, Python 3.10.18, reaching the services over an SSH tunnel (ping RTT about 30 ms)
